'''Kessel tea''' was a type of [[Tea/Legends|tea]] from [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]. As exposure to sunlight rendered the active ingredients inert, it was originally only found in the [[Spice mines of Kessel/Legends|spice mines of Kessel]].<ref name="SWG:KT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=item|Kessel Tea}}</ref> For this reason, it was a valuable contraband good during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other|Smuggler Quest: "Smuggle Illicit Contraband"}}</ref>
